topic: Hand and erosive OA: Heberden nodes, Bouchard nodes, trapeziometacarpal OA

source.title: The clinical, functional, and radiological features of hand osteoarthritis: TLAR-osteoarthritis multi-center cohort study
source.whyItFits: Open multicentre description of hand osteoarthritis. It names Heberden and Bouchard nodes and bony enlargement as the clinical hallmarks, lists the target joints including the thumb base, and defines thumb-base deformity as subluxation and adduction. The 2018 EULAR hand-OA recommendations were not available as an open PDF from this environment.
